title: Chicago drummers: Tubby Hall and Bill Winston
summary: They remember Chicago drummers and joke about Bill Winston as a gun hobbyist.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, getting back to these drummers, (inaudible) drummers even though we're changing cities. Back
in the '30s right here, talking about this, did you know Tuggy Tedley Hall (PHONETIC) out in Chicago, Tuggy Hall?
Yeah, I know the name very well.
Tubby, oh, yeah, Tubby Hall. And Bill Weston, yes.

Bill Winston. He was Johnson's buddy. All them guys all carried those guns and pistols and rifles.
Oh, yeah, he was a gun nut.
